problem_type: Test module graph depends on local application build outputs
symptom: Unit and walkthrough contracts fail ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on clean CI checkout.
direct_cause: agent-runtime-walk-support imported lane catalog and coding names from dist-electron.
class_root: Test module declarations were not constrained to checked-in sources.
affected_population: Local checkout with stale or missing build outputs
entry_points: Agent runtime unit suites import walk support
MCP and Comfy journeys derive expectations from production catalogs
internal_only_reason: Repository-owned test module boundary. Reuse installed tsx 4.22.3 public cjs API (dist/cjs/api/index.d.cts); no runtime dependency upgrade or new loader.
invariants: Test module declarations resolve from source without building the Electron application.
generality_proof: The shared AST gate scans all tests code extensions, including support modules without a test suffix, and rejects static imports, re-exports, dynamic imports and literal require calls targeting repository build directories.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject build-directory test module declarations before CI execution.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Two direct imports reproduced failure in both importing unit suites after deleting dist-electron.
Four dynamic artifact imports detected by the red gate and replaced by scoped source require.
Resident imports this helper at load time; source require removes the hidden path.join artifact dependency.

recurrence.reason: Every fresh runner and stale local build can reproduce the missing or wrong module graph.
same_class_scan: rg dist-electron tests: checked shared support plus MCP/Comfy direct module imports.
Separately inspected _mcpJourney top-level path.join require and actual Electron app.evaluate probes; application-internal probes observe the built target, not a test expectation module.

prevention.invariant: No repository build directory in a test module declaration.
prevention.failure_mode: check:test-waits exits nonzero with file and line.
prevention.strategy: AST scan of import/export and loader call module specifiers, including non-unit support files.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaced build-based expectation imports with scoped tsx source loads; no fallback.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing tsx source transformation API; no dependency change. Scoped cjs API supports the extensionless CJS source graph on Node 24, unlike scoped ESM tsImport in the local experiment.

migration: No user data migration. E2E target application still needs its normal local build.
residual_risks: Computed application-internal module paths are not test import declarations and remain outside this lexical module-specifier gate.
